You Won’t Believe What $340K Buys in Belton, TX! Living in Belton, TX
Step inside this beautiful $340,000 home in Belton, TX located in the highly sought-after Three Creeks master-planned community! 🏡 This stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bath home is full of upgrades, space, and charm — and it’s zoned for top-rated Belton ISD.

In this full house tour, we’ll show you:
✔️ The gorgeous interior layout with high ceilings & split floor plan
✔️ Spacious living room with open-concept kitchen
✔️ Upgraded finishes: granite counters, espresso cabinets, tile flooring
✔️ A backyard oasis with full landscaping & privacy features
✔️ Unique exterior with brick, limestone, and large porch columns

📍 Address: 5349 Lancaster, Belton, TX
🏠 Square Footage: 1,818 sqft
🛏️ Bedrooms: 4 | 🛁 Bathrooms: 3
📅 Year Built: 2018
🎯 Listed Price: $340,000
🎓 School District: Belton ISD

Whether you're a first-time buyer, relocating to Central Texas, or looking for a move-in-ready home with all the landscaping done — this home is a standout in Belton’s competitive market!
